info.title: Multi Registrar API Reference
info.description: Multi domain registrar Api specification and documentation.

post.description: You can get a list of all domains by this request.

requestBody.description: You can get a list of all domains by this request.

total.description: Count of domains in a page between 1-20.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/domains" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "page"="1" \
    -d "total"="10" \
    -d "domain"="1" \
    -d "status"="1" \
    -d "expDate"="2021-10-10" \
    -d "sort.field"="domain" \
    -d "sort.order"="asc"

get.description: You can get a domain by this request.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/info" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod"

post.description:
You can check if domain is available or not in selected period and type. if for some reason domain was not available, reason will be returned.

Returned price value currency is Rial.

requestBody.description:
You can check if domain is available or not in selected period and type. if for some reason domain was not available, reason will be returned.

Returned price value currency is Rial.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain name you need to check.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/check" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod"

get.description: You can get whois of domain by this request.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod"

put.description:
By this action you can update domain's dnssec.

Your request for update dns sec must be like this:
![Response Usage!](dnseclist.jpg "Response Usage")

requestBody.description:
By this action you can update domain's dnssec.

Your request for update dns sec must be like this:
![Response Usage!](dnseclist.jpg "Response Usage")

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X PUT "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/dns-sec" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "dnsSecList"="[{},{}]"

delete.description: By this action you can delete domain's dnssec.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X DELETE "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/dns-sec" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod"

post.description:
Create contact for domain. in this api you can create contact according to your domain registry. after a contact
is created, a verification email will send to owner. note: '.ir' contacts are not supported.

requestBody.description:
Create contact for domain. in this api you can create contact according to your domain registry. after a contact
is created, a verification email will send to owner. note: '.ir' contacts are not supported.

tld.description: Which tld you want to create contact.

fax.description: Domain owner fax (copy phone if not exists).

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/contact/create" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "tld"="com" \
    -d "email"="info@example.com" \
    -d "name"="John Smith" \
    -d "country"="DK" \
    -d "state"="Byen" \
    -d "city"="Copenhagen" \
    -d "address"="st 36 block 3" \
    -d "postCode"="32547" \
    -d "phone"="+1.12345678" \
    -d "fax"="+1.12345678" \
    -d "organization"="some org"

post.description:
Get information about an existing contact. empty value will remove from response.

statuses are depends on registrar.

requestBody.description:
Get information about an existing contact. empty value will remove from response.

statuses are depends on registrar.

tld.description: Tld name which contact belongs to.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/contact/info" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "tld"="com" \
    -d "object"="CCOM-1234567"

post.description:
By this action you can register a new domain. In type of (register with contact) you should enter contact parameter and
for (register with handle) you should enter value for holder,billing,admin,tech.

requestBody.description:
By this action you can register a new domain. In type of (register with contact) you should enter contact parameter and
for (register with handle) you should enter value for holder,billing,admin,tech.

period.description: Period is a time for register domain and between 1-10 years.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/domain/register" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "domain"="example.com" \
    -d "period"="1" \
    -d "confirmPrice"="1" \
    -d "dnsList"="[ns1.iranserver.com,ns2.iranserver.com]" \
    -d "contact"="[{},{}]" \
    -d "holder"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "billing"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "admin"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "tech"="CCOM-132455"

put.description: By this action you can renew a domain.

requestBody.description: By this action you can renew a domain.

period.description: Period is a time for renew domain and between 1-12 years.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X PUT "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/renew" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "period"="1" \
    -d "confirmPrice"="1"

put.description: By this action you can update domain's dns.

requestBody.description: By this action you can update domain's dns.

dnsList.description: Set DNS of domain as array.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X PUT "http://multi.localhost/domain/{domain}/dns" \

    -d "dnsList"="[ns1.iranserver.com,ns2.iranserver.com]"

requestBody.description: By this action you can lock the domain

parameters.name: status

x-code-samples.source:

put.description: By this action you can change contact's domain

requestBody.description: By this action you can change contact's domain

x-code-samples.source:

post.description: By this action you can transfer the domain. you should fill contact array or holder,billing,admin,tech

x-code-samples.source:

    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "domain"="example.com" \
    -d "epp"="ir0uH%8U$86ge" \
    -d "dnsList"="[ns1.iranserver.com,ns2.iranserver.com]" \
    -d "contacts"="[]" \
    -d "holder"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "billing"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "admin"="CCOM-132455" \
    -d "tech"="CCOM-132455"

(0: deactive, 1: active, 3: expiring, 2: expire, 5: redemption, 4: phishing, 6: filter)

    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod"

post.description:
Get statistic of payable request like register, renew or transfer in range of year or month.
you can use this response to generate charts.

![Response Usage!](stats.png "Response Usage")

requestBody.description:
Get statistic of payable request like register, renew or transfer in range of year or month.
you can use this response to generate charts.

![Response Usage!](stats.png "Response Usage")

tld.description: name of tld you want to get statistic.

sum.description: Set true if you want to sum all registrars together.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X POST "http://multi.localhost/statistics/requests" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJod" \

    -d "registrars"="[1]" \
    -d "jobs"="["RegisterJob"]" \
    -d "tld"="" \
    -d "range"="year" \
    -d "sum"="false"

get.description: Get list of resellers with extra data.

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET -G "http://multi.localhost/reseller/index[/{page}]" \
